notes: CR 603.4 (intervening 'if'): the ability checks its condition when the trigger event occurs and triggers only if it is true; if it triggers, it checks again on resolution. Printed: 'When this creature enters, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.' Turret Ogre enters alone, so it never triggers. The entry's triggers are held (hold_triggers: the 'in response' stand-in) and a 4/4 enters before anything resolves: there is still nothing to resolve, the opponent stays at 20. Before the fix the condition was read only at resolution (binding.py _fire), so the firing was queued anyway and dealt 2 once the 4/4 had arrived (18). Companion: intervening_if_false_on_resolution.json.
